findings.line: G55 closed loop, median distance from the recorded path at 2 s, the {num truck_closed_loop xtrack_2s after} models after lebowski; lebowski {v truck_closed_loop xtrack_2s lebowski_877m median cm1} cm. {v truck_closed_loop xtrack_2s lebowski_877m n int} windows from {v truck_closed_loop xtrack_2s lebowski_877m clusters int} drives.
findings.text: Each model drives a model of the G55's steering and powertrain in worldmodel-4B from {v truck_closed_loop xtrack_2s lebowski_877m n int} recorded G55 windows from {v truck_closed_loop xtrack_2s lebowski_877m clusters int} drives. With fewer than 10 drives there are no intervals, so these medians are not yet separated from drive-to-drive variation. Started 2° off heading, the medians at 2 s are {lo truck_recovery heading_xtrack_2s all median cm1} to {hi truck_recovery heading_xtrack_2s all median cm1} cm (lebowski {v truck_recovery heading_xtrack_2s lebowski_877m median cm1}); started 0.5 m off centre, {lo truck_recovery offcentre_xtrack_2s all median cm1} to {hi truck_recovery offcentre_xtrack_2s all median cm1} cm (lebowski {v truck_recovery offcentre_xtrack_2s lebowski_877m median cm1}).

findings.figure: {v truck_open_loop lat_mae lebowski_877m value d2} m/s²
findings.line: G55 open loop, lateral error against what the truck did: lebowski, the lowest of {num truck_open_loop lat_mae all} models. The {num truck_open_loop lat_mae after} after it {lo truck_open_loop lat_mae after value d2}–{hi truck_open_loop lat_mae after value d2}; the {num truck_open_loop lat_mae before} before it {lo truck_open_loop lat_mae before value d2}–{hi truck_open_loop lat_mae before value d2}. {v truck_open_loop lat_mae lebowski_877m n int} windows from {v truck_open_loop lat_mae lebowski_877m clusters int} drives.
findings.text: Mean absolute difference between each model's lateral request and the truck's lateral acceleration, over {v truck_open_loop lat_mae lebowski_877m n int} G55 windows from {v truck_open_loop lat_mae lebowski_877m clusters int} drives, the models' first public dates 2023-11 to 2026-10. In closed loop (above) lebowski has the largest median distance of the {num truck_closed_loop xtrack_2s all} models scored there.
